n = int(input().strip())
input_line = input()

import re

regex_pattern = r"\([\w_]*\)"
segments = re.split(regex_pattern, input_line)

max_word_len = 0
for segment in segments:
    max_in_segment = max((len(s) for s in segment.split('_')), default=0)
    if max_in_segment > max_word_len:
        max_word_len = max_in_segment

pattern = re.compile(regex_pattern)
matches = pattern.findall(input_line)

inside_count = 0
for match in matches:
    inside = match[1:-1]  # remove parentheses
    inside_parts = [s for s in inside.split('_') if s]
    inside_count += len(inside_parts)

print(f"{max_word_len} {inside_count}")
